baseline.instruction: Refresh remotes and create the ASMA-7881 submodule branch from current origin/master before editing. The checked-out gitlink predates the merged OP-01, OP-05 and OP-06 implementations and their schema-lineage convergence fixes. Preserve this untracked handoff when switching.

domain_model.identity: Add OpenQuestionId and, if stable event addressing needs it, OpenQuestionDispositionId to kontor-core/src/id.rs.
domain_model.aggregate: OpenQuestion is project-scoped and epic-attached. Its immutable header carries subject, a typed record-or-document attachment, original author SeatBindingId, write-time Shareability, creation instant and aggregate revision. Its current state is derived from append-only rounds, dispositions and deferred-trigger firings.
domain_model.rounds: A round carries its author, why the state is ambiguous, a non-empty ordered option set, its ordinal and an optional superseded-round reference. A correction appends a successor round and never edits the predecessor.
domain_model.dispositions: Use one closed enum with exactly resolved(deciding_record), deferred(concrete_reopening_trigger), and not_relevant(reason). Every disposition record has an author and immutable sequence/id. A correction appends a disposition that names the disposition it supersedes.
domain_model.reopening: Firing the exact trigger named by the current deferred disposition appends a trigger-firing record and makes the aggregate open again. It does not delete or rewrite the deferred disposition.
domain_model.shareability: Construct the default with Shareability::default_for(ShareabilityTier::ProjectKnowledge), yielding project_shared. Persist the full class/classifier/provenance stamp on the question header and offer no reclassification method.
domain_model.authority: Raising accepts any valid SeatBindingId and performs no role/capability check. Disposition authority is data-defined: architectural/product scopes require the configured architecture closer and process/routing scopes require the configured process closer. Do not branch on literal LSA or TPM inside kontor-core; seed those codes in the Operational domain pack and validate that both exist in the pinned role catalog.

detector.contract: A pure function takes immutable typed observations and returns a stable ordered Vec<OpenQuestionFinding>. It receives no repository, mutable aggregate or command port.
findings: two simultaneously accepted decision records for the same subject with different content hashes
a citation whose exact decision revision is marked superseded
a deferred disposition whose exact named trigger appears in the fired-trigger observations
detector.boundary: The detector only reports. Reopening occurs only through the explicit aggregate/repository trigger-firing operation; detecting a finding never auto-resolves, auto-defers, auto-closes or writes.

persistence.migration: Append schema v41 as 0041_open_questions.sql and increment the migration inventory. Use an open_questions head row plus immutable child tables for rounds, dispositions and trigger firings. Only the aggregate head/revision may change under compare-and-swap; child UPDATE and DELETE must be refused by schema triggers.
persistence.foreign_keys: Every row is project-scoped. The question names its MiniProject, author SeatBinding and attachment metadata without allowing a cross-project reference. Child primary/foreign keys include project_id so tenant isolation does not rely on globally unique UUIDs.
persistence.repository_port: Add a narrow OpenQuestionRepository port with raise, get, list_for_epic, append_correction, disposition/supersede_disposition, and fire_deferred_trigger operations. Each mutating operation is atomic and revision-checked; there is no generic update or delete.
persistence.backup: Add typed deterministic export/import rows for every new table. Snapshot restore then follows SQLite automatically; add explicit export/import and snapshot/reopen assertions so every round, disposition, trigger firing and shareability stamp survives.

completion_gate.predicate: Add a pure kontor-policy predicate returning typed blockers that include OpenQuestionId and subject. An undispositioned or reopened question blocks; any current resolved, deferred-with-unfired-trigger, or not_relevant disposition releases that question.
completion_gate.integration: Wire the existing operational_default@1 completion path so the question predicate is evaluated from a fresh repository read immediately before MarkDone. A blocker must keep the completion non-terminal and appear in its typed blocker projection with the question identity. Make only the minimum scheduler/daemon/API projection edits needed for this existing completion surface; do not create an open-question escalation or notification surface.
completion_gate.freshness: Do not freeze the question set when completion starts: a question may be raised or a deferred trigger may fire during later completion phases. The pre-Done read must therefore be current and project/epic-scoped.

role_instruction.surface: Extend the resolved prompt text used for every ordinary team seat, both root and downstream activation, with the duty to record an open question before proceeding on an unevidenced assumption.
role_instruction.rule: The text creates a duty, not a scanner, capability, role or new standing run. Preserve the existing wait instruction for downstream seats.

core_property_tests: disposition truth table and exactly-three variant parse/serde behavior
deferred requires a concrete non-empty trigger
trigger mismatch refuses and matching trigger reopens
round and disposition corrections append superseding history without changing prior bytes
any seat can raise; configured closer split governs disposition
default shareability is project_shared and immutable
policy_scheduler_tests: undispositioned/reopened question produces a blocker naming id and subject
each valid disposition releases the gate
a question raised or reopened after completion start still prevents MarkDone
release occurs after the current question is dispositioned
detector_tests: input aggregate and repository state are byte-identical before and after detection
store_tests: migration inventory and schema immutability triggers
mutation_targets: detector writes or changes aggregate state
new escalation, notification or auditor-role surface

prohibitions: No Escalation aggregate or second escalation state machine.
No notification transport or interactive prompt channel.
No ambiguity auditor role code, seat, standing scan or background service.
No raw role-name authorization in generic core code.
No in-place UPDATE or DELETE of rounds, dispositions or trigger history.
No public open-question API/CLI/MCP expansion unless the existing completion projection requires a typed blocker addition.
